basics.name: Josué Getsemani Sandoval Villarreal
basics.label: DevOps / Platform Engineer (Semi-Senior)
basics.summary: DevOps / Platform Engineer focused on deployment automation, CI/CD and cloud (AWS). I automate the install and deployment of integration platforms, design multi-brand release pipelines with secret management, and standardize container images with a focus on security and vulnerability remediation. Solid backend background (Java/Spring).

work.name: CITI Value in Real Time
highlights: Deployment automation with a Go CLI for provisioning/deploying an integration platform (tenants, roles/scopes, user stores, Key Manager, Open Banking API).
CI/CD in Azure DevOps: multi-brand release pipelines (deploy-only, release-time versioning) and database migration gates (Flyway).
Secrets migration from variable groups to AWS Secrets Manager (ECS task secrets).
Base image standardization (Node LTS, Alpine/Debian) and CVE remediation; image scanning (Vuls, Checkmarx).
AWS infrastructure: ECS/Fargate, ECR, ElastiCache (Redis TLS+auth), DynamoDB, CloudWatch, EventBridge, CloudFormation.

work.name: CITI Value in Real Time
highlights: Mobile payments backend; migration of relational databases (Oracle/MariaDB) to GCP Cloud Spanner.
Persistence re-engineering (UUID vs autoincrement, Hibernate dialects), HikariCP, Google Cloud Logging.
Reconciliation and settlement batch jobs. Java 8, Spring, MuleSoft ESB, Maven.
